tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check the studio: ffmpeg, yt-dlp and Whisper availability, studio URL and the open project. Call this first.

tools.name: get_editor_rules
tools.description: Return the full faceless-YouTube editing ruleset (roles, footage rules, pacing, hook, transitions, audio, QC, deliverables). Read once at the start of a production.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full timeline state: settings, tracks, assets and every clip with frame/ms positions and YouTube sources.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List saved projects.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new empty project and open it in the studio.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a saved project by id.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Change project name, script, niche/topic (used to refine YouTube queries), colour grade preset, accent colour or music level.

tools.name: set_script
tools.description: Store the full script text. It is the source of truth for spelling, names, dates and numbers while the audio controls timing.

tools.name: set_metadata
tools.description: Save the five title ideas and five thumbnail texts (included in the QC report).

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last edit.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List library assets (video, audio, images) with ids you can place.

tools.name: delete_assets
tools.description: Remove assets from the library (their files too). unused:true removes everything not placed on the timeline.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Copy a local file (video, audio or image) into the project library. Optionally place it on the timeline.

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

audio.description: For videos that have sound: true = play the video’s own audio on the timeline, false = import it silent. ASK THE USER which one they want. The sound can still be separated later with detach_audio.

tools.name: import_voiceover
tools.description: Import the voiceover audio, put it on A1 at 0:00 (replacing any previous voiceover). Next: transcribe_voiceover.

tools.name: use_asset_as_voiceover
tools.description: Use an asset already in the library as the voiceover (A1).

tools.name: transcribe_voiceover
tools.description: Word-level timestamps for the voiceover (Whisper if installed, script-aligned otherwise), then locks the timeline length to the voice end and builds visual beats. Long audio may return a jobId: poll get_job.

model.description: Whisper model: tiny, base, small, medium, large

tools.name: set_transcript
tools.description: Provide your own word timings (e.g. from an external Whisper run). Words: [{w, s, e}] in ms. Rebuilds sentences and beats.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Sentences with ms timings (set words:true for every word).

tools.name: build_beats
tools.description: Re-segment the transcript into visual beats (≤5 s each, paced for retention). Resets beat notes; existing clips keep their beatId only if ids still exist.

tools.name: get_beats
tools.description: The sentence visual map: every beat with exact ms window, spoken text, keywords, suggested YouTube queries, notes and whether it has a clip.

tools.name: update_beat
tools.description: Save your director notes on a beat: meaning/visual idea, emotion, better search queries, keywords, whether it needs a fact overlay — or just edit its text.

tools.name: delete_beat
tools.description: Delete a beat (and its note). Clips placed on it are kept.

tools.name: add_beat
tools.description: Add one beat manually: {startMs, endMs, text}.

tools.name: set_beats
tools.description: Replace the beat list wholesale (advanced): [{startMs,endMs,text,keywords?,queries?}]. Boundaries must tile 0..voiceEnd with no gaps.

tools.name: set_chapters
tools.description: Set chapters: [{title,startMs}] (Hook, Setup, Rising Action, Climax, Payoff, CTA).

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Search YouTube. license:"cc" restricts to Creative Commons uploads. style:"faceless" filters out vlogs/interviews/reactions (adds "no talking"), style:"movie" narrows to movie/film scenes. Returns id, url, title, channel, duration, views.

tools.name: youtube_info
tools.description: Full details for a video: license, chapters, "most replayed" peaks (great in-points), max quality, description.

tools.name: inspect_youtube
tools.description: LOOK at a stretch of a YouTube video: returns a contact-sheet image (frames left-to-right, top-to-bottom) so you can judge relevance, cleanliness (watermarks, logos, burned-in text) and the exact moment. Keep ranges short (≤20 s) for precision, or scan up to 15 min with 12–24 frames to find the right area.

tools.name: find_clips_for_beat
tools.description: Server-side candidate search for a beat: runs its queries, ranks results by the editing rules and proposes an in-point. You still decide — inspect_youtube the best ones.

tools.name: download_youtube
tools.description: Download a section of a YouTube video into the library (only that part is fetched, 1 s padding each side). Optionally place it.

withAudio.description: REQUIRED. true = also download the video’s audio and play it on the timeline; false = picture only. ASK THE USER before calling — never assume.

tools.name: get_framesflow_skill
tools.description: READ FIRST. The Framesflow skill: how to operate this studio, and how every kind of video is made (faceless YouTube documentaries / cash-cow channels, explainers, listicles, shorts, promos, tutorials, music videos…), with sourcing/rights guidance and exact tool recipes. Call with no arguments for SKILL.md plus the list of reference files, then call again with file:"references/cash-cow-documentaries.md" (or any listed file).

file.description: a path from the list, e.g. references/video-types.md

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the web for openly licensed images (Openverse: Wikimedia Commons, Flickr, NASA, museums…). Defaults to licences that allow commercial use. Each result has url, thumbnail, size, creator and licence. Then call import_image with the url you want. Tip: for a cut-out subject use pngOnly:true and/or search "<thing> isolated"; any image can be cut out with remove_background.

source.description: restrict to one collection, e.g. wikimedia, flickr, nasa, smithsonian

licenseType.description: commercial = only licences that allow monetised use

tools.name: import_image
tools.description: Download an image from a public https URL (e.g. from search_images) into the library, logging its licence/credit. removeBackground:true also cuts the subject out into a transparent PNG (the cut-out becomes the asset to use). Optionally place it on the timeline; transparent cut-outs default to contain-fit so the whole subject shows, and can then be animated with set_keyframes (scale, x, y, rotation, opacity) on an overlay track like V2.

credit.description: pass the fields from search_images so credits are logged

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Cut the subject out of an image in the library and save it as a new transparent PNG asset (runs locally with an open-licence AI model; the first run downloads ~45 MB, then ~25 s per image on CPU). Use the returned assetId on an overlay track (V2) for animated cut-outs. replaceClips:true swaps every clip that uses the original image for the cut-out.

tools.name: animation_guide
tools.description: READ THIS before writing HTML animations: the contract (deterministic, seekable, transparent), what is allowed, how to reference library images with asset://<id>, how to build full animated scenes, and a worked example. HyperFrames-style: your HTML is seeked frame by frame and rendered to a transparent video clip.

tools.name: list_animation_templates
tools.description: Ready-made animated scenes you can drop in with create_animation {template, vars}: title card, lower third, big counting number, animated bar chart. Each lists its variables.

tools.name: snapshot_animation
tools.description: LOOK at an animation before rendering it: returns a contact sheet of frames (default at 0%, 33%, 66%, 97% of the clip) over a grey background so you can check layout, overflow, timing and style. Cheap and fast; use it to iterate on your HTML, then call create_animation.

html.description: your own HTML (see animation_guide). Ignored when template is set

tools.name: create_animation
tools.description: Make an animation clip from HTML/CSS/JS (or a template) — like HyperFrames: the page is seeked frame by frame in a headless browser and rendered to a TRANSPARENT video the size of the project, imported to the library and (with place) put on the timeline as a normal clip you can move, trim, fade, scale and keyframe. Use it for titles, lower thirds, counters, charts, icons, callouts, animated cut-outs (asset://<id>) and full animated scenes. Read animation_guide first; check with snapshot_animation. Needs Edge or Chrome installed. Runs as a job (poll get_job if it returns running).

html.description: your own HTML (see animation_guide). Ignored when template is set

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

place.description: put it on the timeline; omit to only add it to the library

tools.name: update_animation
tools.description: Re-render an existing animation asset with new variables, new html and/or a new duration. Every clip using the old asset is switched to the new render (positions, effects and keyframes are kept).

tools.name: place_clip
tools.description: Put a clip on the timeline. For YouTube footage pass youtube:{url,startMs} — only that moment is downloaded. With beatId the clip lands on the beat’s exact frame window (replacing the beat’s previous clip). Enforces: ≤5 s on V1, no source reuse, max 3 per video, never back-to-back from one video.

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

startMs.description: exact in-point in the source video

dur.description: frames (4–12 typical; up to 120 for long dissolves)

withAudio.description: For YouTube footage: also download + play its audio (ASK THE USER; default is picture only). For library video: overrides the asset’s audio setting.

replace.description: false keeps existing clips (default true when beatId is used)

tools.name: add_overlay
tools.description: Add a graphic on V2, timed to spoken words: fact card (name/date/place/number), chapter card, lower third, big stat, quote or title. Dark translucent rounded box, white text, one accent colour. Never use for subtitles.

tools.name: add_audio
tools.description: Place music (A2) or sound effects (A3) from the library. Music is auto-ducked under the voice and faded out at the voice end; gainDb defaults to the project music level (−30 dB).

tools.name: edit_clip
tools.description: Patch one or more clips. Fields: start/dur (frames), in (source ms), speed, volume, gainDb, fadeIn/fadeOut (frames), scale, x, y (percent), opacity, kenburns, grade (preset name or {brightness,contrast,saturation,teal,vignette,sharpen,denoise}), transition {type,dur}, label, track, text{...}.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.description: Move a clip to a new start time (ms) and optionally another track.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Trim a clip: change duration (ms) and/or source in-point (ms).

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split a clip at a timeline time (ms). Keyframes are split across the cut.

tools.name: delete_clips
tools.description: Remove clips by id. ripple:true closes the gap on that track.

tools.name: duplicate_clips
tools.description: Duplicate clips right after themselves (or at offsetMs).

tools.name: add_clips_raw
tools.description: Insert clips exactly as given (used by the studio for paste/drop). Prefer place_clip.

tools.name: add_track
tools.description: Add an extra video (new top layer) or audio track.

tools.name: remove_track
tools.description: Remove a track and every clip on it.

tools.name: reorder_tracks
tools.description: Reorder tracks (top of the list = topmost video layer).

tools.name: set_track
tools.description: Mute/lock/solo or rename a track.

tools.name: apply_look
tools.description: Apply a colour/transition style to the whole video in one go: grade preset (project-wide), and optionally a transition for every cut or Ken Burns on stills.

dur.description: frames (4–12 typical; up to 120 for long dissolves)

onlyEvery.description: apply transition to every Nth clip

tools.name: clear_timeline
tools.description: Remove every clip from the given tracks (default: V1 and V2). Voiceover is kept unless A1 is listed.

tools.name: list_transitions
tools.description: The inbuilt transition catalog: id, label, group and default duration (frames) for each.

tools.name: list_effects
tools.description: The inbuilt per-clip effect catalog with every parameter and its range.

tools.name: list_text_presets
tools.description: Text clip catalogs: in/out animations, fonts, kinds and positions.

tools.name: add_text_clip
tools.description: Add a styled, animated text clip (title, lower third, caption…). kind picks the layout; style overrides anything: font, fontSize, weight, color, stroke, strokeWidth, shadow, bg, align, letterSpacing, animIn, animOut, animDur.

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

dur.description: frames (4–12 typical; up to 120 for long dissolves)

tools.name: set_text_style
tools.description: Edit an existing text clip: change words (text:{title,body,label}) and/or the full style object.

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.description: Apply an effect from the catalog to a clip (e.g. blur, vignette, glow, glitchfx). Get ids from list_effects. Effects stack in order.

tools.name: update_effect
tools.description: Change parameters of one effect instance on a clip (get instance ids from get_project → clip.effects).

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.description: Remove one effect instance from a clip.

tools.name: clear_effects
tools.description: Remove every effect from one clip (clipId) or from all clips.

tools.name: set_keyframes
tools.description: Animate a property over time: scale, x, y, rotation, opacity or volume. Pass keys:[{frame,value,interp}] (frames relative to the clip start; interp: linear|ease|hold) or add:{frame,value} to set one key at the playhead.

tools.name: clear_keyframes
tools.description: Remove keyframes from a clip (one property or all).

tools.name: detach_audio
tools.description: Detach the sound of a video clip onto its own audio track (same timing/volume) so it can be moved, cut, faded or muted separately. The video clip becomes silent. Needs a video clip whose asset has audio.

tools.name: set_asset_audio
tools.description: Choose whether a library video plays its own audio when placed on the timeline (new placements use this setting). Existing clips can be changed with edit_clip {audio:true|false}.

tools.name: add_effect_layer
tools.description: Add an EFFECT LAYER: a separate timeline layer (own track) that applies effects to everything beneath it for its duration, like an adjustment layer. Pass effects:[{type,params?,keyframes?}] (types from list_effects). Animate it afterwards with set_effect_keyframes. Returns clipId and the effect instance ids.

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

tools.name: set_effect_keyframes
tools.description: Animate ONE PARAMETER of an effect over time (works on effect layers and on effects applied to normal clips). Keyframable params per effect: blur(amount) sharpen(amount) exposure(brightness,contrast) saturation(amount) hue(deg) tint(amount) sepia(amount) grayscale(amount) vignette(amount,softness) grain(amount) glow(amount,radius) pixelate(size) chromatic(shift) posterize(levels). Pass keys:[{frame,value,interp}] (frames relative to the clip start, interp linear|ease|hold) or add:{frame,value}.

tools.name: clear_effect_keyframes
tools.description: Remove keyframes from an effect parameter (or all parameters of that effect instance).

tools.name: set_markers
tools.description: Replace all timeline markers: [{frame|ms, label?, color?}].

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Add one marker at a time position (ms or frame).

tools.name: set_project_format
tools.description: Set canvas format/size (formatId from FORMATS: hd, hd720, uhd, vertical — 16:9 or 9:16 ONLY — or raw width/height), fps (24/25/30/50/60 — clips are rescaled) and voiceLock (lock the video length to the voiceover end, used by the AI pipeline).

tools.name: set_mix
tools.description: Store the user’s mix decision for this video: percentages of YouTube footage, images and animation. Must sum to 100 and no single type may be 100. Call this AFTER asking the user — never decide the mix yourself.

tools.name: set_plan
tools.description: Store (or replace) the shot list: rows covering the voiceover back-to-back with no gaps or overlaps. Each row: {startMs,endMs, type:"youtube"|"image"|"animation", line (the exact spoken words), and per type — youtube: url,inMs,outMs,title,channel,watermark?,mask?{x,y,w,h 0..1}; image: assetId; animation: kind (stat/counter/quote/list/comparison/timeline/chapter) + graphic{...}}. Rows must respect the 14 rules in get_editor_rules.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: The current plan: the user’s mix %, every shot-list row (voiceover window, source cut, watermark notes) and per-row coverage on the timeline.

tools.name: exec_plan
tools.description: Materialise the shot list onto the timeline. For youtube rows: downloads ONLY the needed seconds and places them exactly on the row window (blurring the watermark region when the row has one). For image rows: places the referenced asset. For animation rows: creates the animated graphic. Runs as a background job — poll get_job.

tools.name: add_animation
tools.description: Add an animated graphic (the browser-rendered equivalent of a motion-graphics clip): kind stat | counter | quote | list | comparison | timeline | chapter, plus its data. Rendered in the preview and baked into the ffmpeg render identically.

track.description: track id, e.g. V1, V2, A1 or an added track like V3/A4

tools.name: set_clip_mask
tools.description: Blur out a watermark/logo/burned-text region on a clip: x,y,w,h are 0..1 fractions of the frame (e.g. bottom-right logo: x:0.8,y:0.86,w:0.18,h:0.1). clear:true removes it. The blur is live in the preview and baked into the render.

tools.name: export_notes
tools.description: Write compact editor notes (overview, one-line-per-shot table, used-clips register, watermark report, QC) to notes.md next to the project — the short version of the documentary-editor PDF, capped so it prints in about 30 pages or fewer.

tools.name: set_playhead
tools.description: Move the studio playhead (and optionally zoom the timeline onto a clip) so the user sees what you are talking about.

tools.name: run_qc
tools.description: Check the edit against the rules: gaps, 5 s cap, reuse, 3-per-video, adjacency, footage ratio, pacing, sync to beats, overlay timing, hook, licences. Returns errors to fix.

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Render the final MP4 with ffmpeg (1080p30 H.264 High, AAC 48 kHz, loudness-normalised to −14 LUFS, ends exactly at the voice end). quality:"draft" is a fast 540p check. Returns a jobId; poll get_job.

tools.name: autopilot
tools.description: Fully automatic mode: for every beat without a clip, search YouTube, rank candidates by the rules, download only the chosen moment and place it exactly on the beat (plus fact overlays). Runs as a job; the user watches the timeline fill in live. Review afterwards with run_qc and replace weak clips.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status/progress/result of a background job (render, autopilot, transcription).

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Recent background jobs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running job.

tools.name: export_package
tools.description: Write the deliverables next to the render: timeline_log.csv/json, transcript_timing.json (editing record, not subtitles), sources.txt (licence flags) and retention_qc_report.md.
